name: headcountlabs-job-search
description: Search current job postings collected from public job boards and company career sites; every job links to its original posting. Tools: search_jobs, get_job, count_jobs (live counts, can group by employer, city, state and more), salary_range, market_lookup and market_breakdown (pay percentiles and job counts from a daily U.S. snapshot), market_dimensions, list_fields and search_docs. Read-only. This keyless endpoint needs no account or API key; one search shows up to 250 jobs, up to 50 per page.
